notes.title: Update Version 1.5
notes.content:
G'day,

Its a long time overdue but 1.5 adds a bit of extra content, fixes a few bugs and FPS issues. If you continue to have issues please let us know by opening a new discussion tab in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/740320/discussions/] Steam Discussion [/url] section and we will address it as soon as possible.

Have a good one.
